title.zh: 慢雾余弦：警惕针对FOMO网页端书签钓鱼攻击
title.en: 慢雾余弦：警惕针对FOMO网页端书签钓鱼攻击

current_state.zh: SlowMist's Yu Xian warned that a novel bookmark-based phishing attack against FOMO's web client tricks users into saving malicious JavaScript as a browser bookmark, hijacking logged-in accounts and draining their crypto assets.
